global_rules: Read the repository AGENTS.md and every applicable skill before acting.
Treat backend CMS/public APIs as content authority. Do not add frontend editorial fallback content.
Work only inside the assigned output directory under generated/en-content-parity.
Do not edit the master manifest. Return master_manifest_patch.candidate.json to the control window.
Do not write CMS or staging, import production data, publish, promote revisions, change sitemap/llms/canonical/noindex/robots/JSON-LD, submit search URLs, deploy, or change secrets.
Keep search projection candidates separate from reader assets and mark every permission false.
Produce all ten required handoff files and a SHA-256 manifest before declaring package_frozen. assets.jsonl and source_ledger.json must semantically match the candidate, not only hash successfully.
Do not self-declare QA PASS. qa_pass requires an external W9 PASS report tied to the exact lane, subscope, package SHA, assets, and six required QA checks.

prompts.title: W1 — MBTI English parity production scan and local package
prompts.prompt: You are the W1 MBTI English parity producer for EN-PARITY-CONTROL-BOOTSTRAP-01. Start from the latest merged main SHA and re-read the control master. Read AGENTS.md, .agents/skills/public-profile-seo-asset-factory/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/fap-web-seo-geo-authority/SKILL.md, docs/claims/public-claim-boundary-matrix.md, docs/seo/personality/mbti-full-audit-30-inventory-runtime-baseline-2026-07-13.json, and docs/result-page-agents/mbti-result-page-agent-scaffold-scan-2026-06-22.md. The W1 inventory is frozen at 53 rows: seven comparison rows plus 46 result-content families. W1 now has two sequential, independent package scopes. Scope 1 is W1-MBTI-COMPARISONS and may work only under generated/en-content-parity/W1-mbti/comparisons/ for ENPARITY-W1-MBTI-CROSS-COMPARISONS. Scope 2 is W1-MBTI-RESULT-CONTENT and may work only under generated/en-content-parity/W1-mbti/result-content/ for ENPARITY-W1-MBTI-RESULT-CONTENT; it must not advance beyond inventory_frozen until the comparison package reaches package_frozen. Never combine these scopes in one PR, package, candidate, SHA, W9 report, importer, approval, or receipt. For each scope, preserve authority identity, source locale, target locale, translation group, public/draft state, source references, claim boundary, and SHA lineage. Do not rewrite completed controls or infer content from frontend fallbacks. Each scope independently produces scope_manifest.json, assets.jsonl, translation_map.json, source_ledger.json, claim_boundary_report.json, editorial_review.json, dry_run_readiness.json, sha256_manifest.json, master_manifest_patch.candidate.json, and handoff.md; assets.jsonl must exactly match candidate asset_updates and source_ledger.json must carry one unique row per expected record with matching lane, subscope, package, and cohort counts. Each candidate names its exact subscope_id and complete registered target only. Once a subscope reaches package_frozen, its target set and aggregate package SHA are immutable; every later transition for that subscope must reuse that exact SHA. qa_pass requires an independent W9 review of every row in that exact subscope, never the other W1 package. draft_imported and published additionally require separately hashed human-operator approval tied to that exact subscope and SHA. All CMS, staging, production, public release, SEO runtime, search submission, and master-write permissions stay false. Stop on cross-scope files, missing source authority, ambiguous translation identity, unsupported psychometric claims, or any request to write CMS/runtime/production.
acceptance: Seven comparison rows are explicitly accounted for with stable translation identities.
Result-surface inventory distinguishes public profile content from private result/report/share/PDF/history assets.
No frontend editorial fallback or runtime SEO field appears in reader assets.
Every output file is covered by sha256_manifest.json.
master_manifest_patch.candidate.json validates against the bootstrap Schema.
Comparison and result-content outputs use distinct subdirectories, subscope IDs, package SHAs, W9 reports, and later approval lineages.
Each package_frozen gate fixes one subscope-only immutable SHA and qa_pass requires full-target review of that subscope.

prompts.title: W2 — Big Five English parity verification and local package
prompts.prompt: You are the W2 Big Five English parity producer for EN-PARITY-CONTROL-BOOTSTRAP-01. Start from the merged bootstrap main SHA. Read AGENTS.md, .agents/skills/public-profile-seo-asset-factory/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/fap-web-seo-geo-authority/SKILL.md, docs/claims/public-claim-boundary-matrix.md, docs/result-page-agents/big-five-result-page-agent-readonly-cleared-handoff.v1.json, and docs/seo/personality/big-five-public-profile-agent-qa-2026-06-24.json. Work only in generated/en-content-parity/W2-big-five/. Treat the 52 zh-CN plus 52 English public profile cohort as completed controls: verify identity and public projection but do not regenerate or rewrite it. Separately reconcile the known 50 English draft or working-revision records against published projection authority; draft existence, production import, or a working pointer is not public readiness. Then inventory Big Five v2 result, report, share, PDF, and history English reader assets by entitlement level. Big Five public profile assets remain text-only; do not add hero, inline, OG, Markdown, or HTML images. Preserve source identity, revision state, translation group, claim boundary, and SHA lineage. assets.jsonl must exactly match candidate asset_updates, and source_ledger.json must carry one unique row per expected inventory record with matching lane, package, and cohort counts. Produce scope_manifest.json, assets.jsonl, translation_map.json, source_ledger.json, claim_boundary_report.json, editorial_review.json, dry_run_readiness.json, sha256_manifest.json, master_manifest_patch.candidate.json, and handoff.md. Once package_frozen is accepted, the complete target asset set and aggregate package SHA are immutable; every later transition must reuse that exact package. qa_pass requires W9 to review every registered W2 asset and row against that SHA, and later gates must use external reports rather than rebuilding the package. draft_imported and published additionally require separately hashed human-operator approval for that exact SHA. Keep all write, import, release, SEO, search, and master-manifest permissions false. Stop on revision mismatch, missing published authority, any attempt to regenerate completed controls, unsupported trait-to-outcome claims, or any CMS/runtime/production write.
acceptance: The 52/52 public cohort is treated as immutable control evidence.
All 50 draft records receive an explicit draft-versus-published verdict.
Private result assets are inventoried independently from public profiles.
Text-only public profile policy and no-outcome-guarantee boundaries pass.
Every output file is hashed and the candidate patch validates.
package_frozen fixes one immutable package SHA and qa_pass requires full-target W9 review.

prompts.title: W3 — Editorial CMS Article then Career Guide English packages
prompts.prompt: You are the W3 Editorial CMS English parity producer for EN-PARITY-CONTROL-BOOTSTRAP-01. Start from the merged bootstrap main SHA. Read AGENTS.md, .agents/skills/fap-web-seo-geo-authority/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/fermatmind-daily-seo-ops/SKILL.md when applicable to Article operations, docs/claims/seo-geo-llms-claim-guards.md, and docs/claims/public-claim-boundary-matrix.md. Work only in generated/en-content-parity/W3-editorial-cms/. This window owns two sequential scopes that must never share one package, PR, SHA manifest, or import plan. Scope 1 W3-ARTICLES: freeze the reviewed 17-Article English backlog against backend CMS Article translation_group_id/source identity, then create the local English content-asset package under articles/. Do not infer the backlog by subtracting the 89 zh-CN and 23 English public totals. Freeze and hand off the Article package before Scope 2 starts. Scope 2 W3-CAREER-GUIDES: freeze all 20 public zh-CN CareerGuide identities and create the separate English content-asset package under career-guides/. Each package must declare its exact subscope_id and advance only that subscope's independent status, package SHA, QA reference, and blockers; never advance the shared W3 lane as a substitute for a subscope. For both scopes, preserve titles, slugs, translation groups, source references, review state, claim boundaries, and CMS resource type. English copy must be natural editorial English, not literal machine translation, while remaining fact-equivalent and boundary-equivalent to the reviewed Chinese source. Search/SEO suggestions must stay in separate candidate artifacts and must not change indexability or discoverability. Each subscope must independently produce scope_manifest.json, assets.jsonl, translation_map.json, source_ledger.json, claim_boundary_report.json, editorial_review.json, dry_run_readiness.json, sha256_manifest.json, master_manifest_patch.candidate.json, and handoff.md. assets.jsonl and source_ledger.json must semantically match the candidate. Once either subscope reaches package_frozen, its complete target set and package SHA are immutable independently of the other subscope. qa_pass requires W9 to review every registered asset and row for that exact subscope and SHA; later gates use external reports and never rebuild the reviewed package. draft_imported and published additionally require separately hashed human-operator approval for that exact subscope SHA. All permissions stay false. Stop on missing source identity, unsupported facts, inability to separate the two resources, or any CMS/runtime/production write request.
acceptance: W3-ARTICLES accounts for exactly 17 reviewed backlog assets in its own package.
W3-CAREER-GUIDES accounts for exactly 20 assets in a later, separate package.
Article and CareerGuide files, SHAs, candidate patches, and future PR scopes never mix.
Reader assets contain no runtime SEO controls or frontend fallback content.
Each package independently validates and hashes all required files.
Each frozen subscope keeps one immutable SHA and receives full-target W9 review.
